definitions.explanation: A pen with an internal reservoir of ink.

examples.japanese: {万年筆|まんねんひつ}で{手紙|てがみ}を{書|か}く。
examples.english: To write a letter with a fountain pen.

examples.japanese: これは{高|たか}い{万年筆|まんねんひつ}です。
examples.english: This is an expensive fountain pen.

examples.japanese: {万年筆|まんねんひつ}にインクを{入|い}れる。
examples.english: To fill a fountain pen with ink.

notes:
{万年筆|まんねんひつ} is literally "ten-thousand-year brush."

ETYMOLOGY:
- {万年|まんねん} (ten thousand years - i.e., long-lasting)
- {筆|ひつ} (writing brush/pen)

RELATED:
- ボールペン (ballpoint pen)
- {鉛筆|えんぴつ} (pencil)
- インク (ink)
